releases.body:
## What's New in v1.7.0

- **Adaptive Role Baseline Binding (`baselineMode`) (`src/core/config.ts`, `src/core/selection.ts`, `src/plugin.ts`):**
  - Adds `baselineMode: "adaptive" | "always" | "fallback"` (default `"adaptive"`) and `resolveBaselineMode()`.
  - Under `"adaptive"`, standalone and non-orchestrated setups preserve legacy `"fallback"` (either-or: lexical router wins, else `role.default`), while mesh-managed profiles (`bindingOwner: "self" | "external"` or `managedBy: "opencode-hi"`) resolve to `"always"`: safe non-project `role.default` baseline skills bind first (enforcing `candidateIds`, `hostAllowed`, `role.allowed`, and `negativeTriggers`) and lexical/semantic routing fills remaining slots up to `maxActive`.
- **Explicit Mesh Binding Ownership (`bindingOwner`) (`src/bridge.ts`, `src/plugin.ts`):**
  - Adds `MeshAgentProfile.bindingOwner?: "self" | "external"` to `src/bridge.ts`.
  - `"self"` suppresses Lazy automatic binding (even under `autoBind: "all"`) while honoring explicit `skill:<id>` and `requiredSkills`; `"external"` permits Lazy automatic binding; unknown values are safely ignored.
- **Verification:**
  - Adds `tests/baseline-mode.test.js` (11 unit & mesh tests) — **210 / 210** passing tests across 16 suites, **42 / 42** JS modules, **0** strict TypeScript errors against `@opencode/plugin@2.4.1`, **0** prod audit vulnerabilities.

## What's Fixed in v1.6.1

- **OpenCode v2.4.x Tool `output` Schema Contract (`src/plugin.ts`):**
  - Adds explicit JSON Schema `output` definitions (`SEARCH_OUTPUT_SCHEMA`, `INFO_OUTPUT_SCHEMA`, `PLAN_OUTPUT_SCHEMA`, `STATUS_OUTPUT_SCHEMA`, `LOAD_OUTPUT_SCHEMA`, `RESOURCE_OUTPUT_SCHEMA`) to all 6 `lazy_skill_*` tool registrations so OpenCode `v2.4.1` host `outputSchema` validation accepts structured `{ content, output }` responses in both standalone and multi-plugin setups.
  - Returns consistent schema-compliant `output` across every branch of `lazy_skill_load` (`{ id, scope, loaded, base }` on vault load) and `lazy_skill_resource` (`{ id, path, bytes }`).
- **Verification:**
  - Adds `tests/tool-output-schema.test.js` validating all 6 tools and every return branch against their declared JSON Schemas (**199 / 199** passing tests, **41 / 41** JS modules, **0** strict typecheck errors, **0** prod vulnerabilities).
  - Verified live inside an isolated `opencode v2.4.1 --standalone` host across all 6 `lazy_skill_*` tools (`hasOutputSchema: true`, `ok: true`).

## What's New in v1.6.0

- **Strict-Frontmatter Compatible BM25F Scoring (`src/core/rank.ts`):**
  - Computes BM25F field length averages (`avg[f]`) exclusively over non-empty documents so sparse metadata fields never distort length normalization.
  - Adds adaptive `description` weight compensation (`1.8 -> 4.5` default) for standard `name + description` skills (Agent Skills / OpenCode V2 / Claude / Antigravity format) plus per-token non-identity metadata saturation.
  - Indexes synthetic `derivedKeywords` / `derivedAliases` at lower weight than explicit frontmatter fields (`3.0` / `2.2` vs `5` / `4`).
- **Safe Bounded Auto-Extraction (`src/core/scanner.ts`, `src/core/catalog.ts`):**
  - Automatically derives bounded technical identifiers (backticks, `@scope/pkg`, `dot.notation`, `camelCase`/`PascalCase`, `kebab-case`, `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE`), `Use when ...` trigger clauses, and `#`/`##` headings from the bounded body prefix without mutating explicit frontmatter fields or reading beyond `maxFrontmatterBytes`.
  - Applied consistently across vault skills, native skills, and `nativeCatalog: "compact"` refresh cycles.
- **Optional Sidecar Metadata (`lazy-skill.json` / `skill.meta.json`):**
  - Safely reads optional per-skill sidecar JSON (`keywords`, `aliases`, `triggers`, `tags`, `negativeTriggers`, `languages`, `roles`) for both vault and native skills and merges with `options.rules` while keeping `SKILL.md` frontmatter pure.
  - Enforces symlink rejection (`lstat` + `O_NOFOLLOW` + `inside`), `maxFrontmatterBytes` cap, UTF-8/prototype-pollution sanitization, and incremental cache invalidation.
- **Expanded 13-Language Concept Bridge (`src/core/concepts.ts`, `src/core/text.ts`):**
  - Adds 5 new 13-language concepts (`plugin`, `permission`, `compaction`, `ui`, `orchestration`; `38` total) and strengthens Turkish→English discovery and language detection.
- **OpenCode v2.4.1 Alignment (`package.json`):**
  - Aligns `@opentui/core` and `@opentui/solid` `peerDependencies` to `>=0.8.0` (matching `@opencode/plugin@2.4.1`) and verifies against `@opencode/plugin@2.4.1` (`198 / 198` tests passing, `40 / 40` JS modules, `0` strict typecheck errors, `0` prod audit vulnerabilities).

releases.name: v1.5.4 — OpenCode v2.4.0 Compatibility & Compaction/Hot-Reload Alignment (opencode-lazy-se)
releases.body:
## v1.5.4

- Align with **OpenCode v2.4.0** (`@opencode/plugin@2.4.0`, `@opentui/core >=0.9.4`, `@opentui/solid >=0.9.4`):
  - Subscribe to `plugin.updated` and `session.compaction.ended` in `src/plugin.ts`; invalidate catalog/policy caches on hot-reloaded plugins and reset session `loads`/`hints` via `SessionLedger.resetCompacted()` after compaction so vault skills can re-bind cleanly.
  - Return structured `output` alongside `content` in `Tool.Result` responses across all `lazy_skill_*` JSON tools.
  - Update `LazySidebar` (`src/tui.tsx`) to consume `sidebar.content` slot `{ sessionID }` input and resolve `context.data.session.get(sessionID)` and `context.data.location.default()`.
  - Raise `peerDependencies` `@opentui/core` and `@opentui/solid` floor to `>=0.9.4` and verify against `@opencode/plugin@2.4.0` (**186 / 186** passing tests).

releases.name: v1.5.3 — Cross-Role Plan Previews, hostAllowed Defense-in-Depth & Diagnostic Clarity (opencode-lazy-se)
releases.body:
## v1.5.3

- Decouple `lazy_skill_plan` target-role previews (`agent: "<role>"`) from the caller session's primary `meshProfile`, infer worker status from host `roster` (`mode: "subagent"`) or configured `roles`, and return `bindReason` (`"bound"`, `"primary_session_off"`, `"below_score_or_coverage_threshold"`, etc.) plus `outsideRoleAllowed`.
- Enforce `hostAllowed` directly inside `selectBindings()` across `requiredSkills` (`deniedRequired`) and `explicit` (`skill:<id>`) branches as defense-in-depth alongside `plugin.ts` host policy verification.
- Include `matched` terms in `lazy_skill_search` default `summary` detail mode and add `roleProfiles` (per-role `allowedCount`, `default`, `maxActive`, `effectiveBindMode`) plus `vaultNote` to `lazy_skill_status`.
- Expand automated verification suite to **185 / 185** passing tests across 13 suites.
